name: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
summary: Children's research hospital in Memphis, funded mostly by donations raised by its fundraising arm ALSAC: treats children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases free to families, runs one of the largest paediatric cancer research programmes, and supports children's cancer care abroad through St. Jude Global.

spending.source: https://www.stjude.org/content/dam/en_US/shared/www/about-st-jude/financial-information/2025%20St.%20Jude%20-%20ALSAC%20combined%20FS%20-%20ADA%20compliant.pdf (FY2025 combined audited accounts, p. 4): St. Jude's own-funded programme spending, the two lines below: research $720.79M plus patient care, training and community programmes $731.58M (excluding grant-funded research, insurers' share of care and ALSAC's joint-cost public education)

lines.label: Research
lines.source: https://www.stjude.org/content/dam/en_US/shared/www/about-st-jude/financial-information/2025%20St.%20Jude%20-%20ALSAC%20combined%20FS%20-%20ADA%20compliant.pdf (FY2025 combined audited accounts, p. 4): research $883.22M less research grants and contracts $162.43M = $720.79M of St. Jude's own funds (cancer and non-cancer research, both modelled as branches). ALSAC's 'public education' ($245.98M of the education, training and community services line) is joint-cost appeal content, counted in both models as fundraising overhead. Patient care, St. Jude Global, clinical training, the graduate school and community programmes are the care programme below.

lines.label: Patient care, St. Jude Global, training and community programmes
lines.source: https://www.stjude.org/content/dam/en_US/shared/www/about-st-jude/financial-information/2025%20St.%20Jude%20-%20ALSAC%20combined%20FS%20-%20ADA%20compliant.pdf (FY2025 combined audited accounts, p. 4): patient care $726.65M less insurers' $141.31M, plus the hospital's education and training $146.24M = $731,577,834 of St. Jude's own funds.
